about_the_game:
Is It Okay to Fall in Love with an Idol?

Note: This is the complete version, which adds individual romance routes to the original free game.

Note: The demo is the "Free Complete Version." You can play through to the ending for free.

"Is It Okay to Fall in Love with an Idol?" is a fresh new romantic comedy visual novel.

You become the manager of the new idol group "Melonchu (♡愛恋人♡)".

To succeed in their debut live concert, romance with the active idols is strictly forbidden... But love flags are popping up left and right, and the members start with MAX affection!

How will you overcome this crisis?

It's a chaotic romantic comedy with a "no dating" rule—a first in the otome game genre (perhaps!?)!

✅ How to Play (Key Gameplay Features)

The story progresses on a common route until the live concert.

  • The Dilemma: Choosing options that increase the idols' affection will decrease the Live Success Rate.

  • Your Goal: Select choices that increase the Live Success Rate to guide the story toward a successful debut!

【Characters】

Kagura Issa (CV: Yoshino Kaku)

Leader of Melonchu. In charge of rap and hand clapping. Self-centered and bossy, but confident in his looks. Fell in love with the manager upon their chance meeting.

Nijo Ranmaru (CV: Fujie Tatsuya)Dance member of Melonchu. His speech is rough, and he has a strong attitude, but he easily shows his affectionate side. Fell in love with the manager upon their chance meeting.

Mitoge Otoha (CV: Inou Koki)SNS member of Melonchu. Low-tension and speaks in mysterious internet slang from the Heisei and Reiwa eras. Fell in love with the manager upon their chance meeting.

Shibaura Reiji (CV: Yoshimura Yuu)Production Accounting staff. Seems to care about you, the new manager. He knows the current affection levels of the Melonchu members and can inform you of them.

Aida Mei (CV: None) Name Change AvailableThe Protagonist (You). She had a favorite idol group long ago, but lost her memory due to the shock of their sudden disbandment.

📦 Included Content & Functionality (What You Get)

Content DetailsIncluded FunctionalityGenre: Romantic Comedy ADV / Visual NovelPlatform: WindowsEstimated Playtime: Approx. 1 hourControls: Mouse and KeyboardEndings: Total 6 types (Branching based on choices)Save / Load / Auto Play / Backlog / Skip functions availableVoice Acting: Full voice acting for all characters (excluding the protagonist)Audio Commentary: Includes audio commentary by the cast

💻 System Specifications

  • Supported Languages: Japanese (Audio, Subtitles, UI)

👩‍💻 Development

This is an original work by Mikimaki.
